primary_object_card.object_statement: The primary object is the complete exact ledger of probe-relative behavioral partition refinement for every unordered distinct ECA rule pair on the periodic nine-bit carrier; deepest witnesses and later learned proxies are readouts from this ledger and may not replace it.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: Run every distinct pair of ECA actions on every nine-bit ring state, repeatedly split states whose admitted futures differ under the fixed probes, and record the complete refinement history without selecting attractive pairs after seeing the answer.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The N6-N8 controller compared 97,920 complete pair ledgers with maximum strict depths 3, 4, and 6.
The exact finite object factory is bounded and real; learned perception and engine-schedule promotion remain unearned.

native_terms.strict refinement depth: The count of partition-changing updates before the first unchanged update.
native_terms.complete pair ledger: One record for every unordered distinct ECA rule pair, with no result-selected fixture subset.
native_terms.hidden audit batch: A label-independent symmetry-orbit partition used only to test whether a later benchmark has enough independent depth-novel mass.
